insights.title: 21% less PM2.5 than last winter
insights.body: Since you started taking Consell de Cent on the way home, your evening rides breathe noticeably cleaner air.

insights.title: Mornings carry most of your dose
insights.body: Rides between 7:30 and 9:00 account for 61% of your weekly PM2.5 exposure. Leaving 20 minutes later lowers it by about a quarter.

insights.title: Average noise 62 dB(A) while riding
insights.body: Above the WHO road-traffic guideline (53 dB), mostly on Diagonal between Pg. de Sant Joan and Glòries.

insights.title: EU 2030 limit: 10 µg/m³
insights.body: Your ride-weighted average is above the 2030 limit, like most commuters on Barcelona's arterials. Calm streets bring it under.
